operators.formula: three phases for operator0, one phase for operator1, followed by one reset-recovery phase

payload.weight_formula: four PWP descriptors * two signed corrections * 8 slots + two fallback descriptors * two sources * 8 slots

accumulator.reads_formula: operator0 phase2 live row 8 + phase3 live row1 8 + operator0 commit two live rows 16 + operator1 commit one live row 8
accumulator.zero_initializations_formula: operator0 first touch of two rows * 8 + operator1 first touch of row1 * 8

invariant_audit.scheduler_order: RTL executes block0..3 for each descriptor in tile0, then repeats block0..3 in tile1. Each admitted row therefore reaches slot7 only after its slot0..6 writes.
invariant_audit.set_rule: row_live_q[row] is written 1 only on an accepted accumulator write with current_slot==7 and prior row_live==0.
invariant_audit.clear_rule: row_live_q[row] is written 0 only on an accepted commit with commit_index==7 and prior row_live==1, apart from global reset.
invariant_audit.ordinary_phase_rule: ST_RELEASE does not clear row_live or forwarding state; final operator commit clears live rows and then clears all forwarding valid bits.
invariant_audit.boundary_rule: After the last slot7 commit, last_valid is cleared and operator_boundary_pending is set; the directed second operator observes no stale forwarding and zero-based first touches despite poisoned SRAM.
invariant_audit.mutation_evidence: The sealed arithmetic attack reproduces first corruption at slot1 for both premature set and premature clear.
invariant_audit.limitation: The set/clear SVA observes debug events that are themselves derived from slot-qualified handshakes; it does not bind directly to row_live_q mutation. The mutation attack is an arithmetic counterexample, not a separately compiled mutated RTL run or formal proof.

narrow_negative_pwp_audit.tb_encoding: For narrow PWP the TB drives only low[7:0], echoes payload_response_narrow and holds the full high side at zero.
narrow_negative_pwp_audit.rtl_decode: M433 sign-extends low_data bit7 into the upper four bits of each signed12 contribution.
narrow_negative_pwp_audit.end_to_end_check: The TB compares every committed signed19 lane against an independent integer expectation; eight narrow negative requests are counted and commit_exact passes.
narrow_negative_pwp_audit.coverage_limit: All narrow negative transactions are one directed operator/tag and a two-row geometry; this is targeted functional evidence, not workload coverage.

physical_boundary_audit.accumulator_interface: The external accumulator uses request/response handshakes and the TB returns reads after two cycles, so combinational external SRAM read is not assumed.
physical_boundary_audit.row_live_read: current_live and commit_live are asynchronous indexed reads of a 3000-entry logic array in production geometry.
physical_boundary_audit.row_live_reset: The entire array is asynchronously reset in a loop. This maps naturally to resettable flops, not a conventional synchronous SRAM macro; a macro implementation needs boot scrub, valid gating and latency retiming.
physical_boundary_audit.unpriced_state: Eight 1824-bit forwarding vectors and tags remain in registers and are not reduced by the 8x row-live bit count claim.
physical_boundary_audit.admitted_scope: functional VCS only; the claimed 24000-to-3000 bit reduction is logical bookkeeping, not area, cycle, power or macro PPA evidence.

findings.finding: No synchronous row-live macro/boot-scrub implementation, DC/STA or power evidence exists. Do not convert 8x logical bit reduction into an area or energy number.
Bind assertions to the actual row_live_q write enable/data/address, or run a compiled RTL mutation/formal proof; present event-proxy SVA is partially self-referential.
ap_payload_stable checks tile/block/pwp only; tag, center, source and narrow are omitted from the backpressure stability tuple.
ROWS_PER_PHASE=2 and one narrow tag exercise the intended corner but do not establish production-geometry address aliasing or randomized response/backpressure coverage.

verdict.required_next_action: Keep M467R4-R3 as functional evidence only; close direct row_live mutation assertions/formal and a synchronous macro-or-flop physical implementation before any PPA claim.
